product.title: Crochet Mommy and Me Set - Beach Coverup
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Lightweight open-knit crochet with an airy beach-coverup feel; exact fiber content was not visible from the blocked vendor page.
  • Family story: A coordinated mom-and-daughter beach set made for warm vacations, resort mornings, and sunny matching photos.
  • Print: Crochet keeps the look clean and coastal with a textured openwork pattern in Black, White, Orange, Apricot, or Green.
  • Design details: Sleeveless V-neck styling, open-knit texture, ribbed waist detail, and matching skirt silhouette for both mom and daughter.
  • Care: Hand wash cold, reshape gently, dry flat in the shade, and avoid bleach or rough poolside surfaces.
  • Size range: Girls Child 6-8 Years to Child 10-12 Years; Mother S to Mother XL.

The Crochet Mommy and Me Set brings a polished beach-coverup moment to mother-daughter matching. The sleeveless open-knit top and skirt styling gives the outfit a breezy resort feel while keeping the look soft, simple, and easy to photograph.

Use it over swimwear for beach walks, resort breakfasts, and vacation portraits, or style it with sandals and woven accessories for warm-weather family outings. The chart-backed size range covers three girls' sizes and four mother sizes, with each variant tied to a row from the attached chart.

Key Features:

  • Open-knit crochet texture: Airy patterning gives the set its coastal coverup look.
  • Mom + daughter match: Same textured styling across girls' and mother sizes.
  • Beach-ready silhouette: Sleeveless V-neck top and skirt-style bottom shown in the supplied product image.
  • Chart-backed sizing: Girls' sizes use age, height, bust, waist, and length guidance; mother sizes use bust, hip, and length.
  • Five color choices: Choose Black, White, Orange, Apricot, or Green for the same chart-backed coverup set.

Choose each size and pack a clean matching beach look for your next sunny family memory.
